# EditsManager

> **File:** `services/ui/EditsManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

The editors' unsaved edits, by overlay page: which pages hold a dirty draft (the navigator's dots and the unsaved-changes strip), and saving or discarding them all at once. Drafts survive leaving a page or closing the overlay, so this reminds rather than blocks. Also the text or number box holding typed text not committed yet (only the focused one can): its page shows Save at once, and Save / Reset commit or drop it first, while it reaches the running shell only on Enter or focus loss (a half-typed command or folder never runs). Also how the editors are laid out, which outlives their pages (saved in state/editors.json): whether the libraries group their types, and whether the bar editor stacks a horizontal bar's sections. And, in memory, where each panel was scrolled to (ScrollMemory).

### Properties

- `unsaved` (readonly var): View types with unsaved edits
- `separate` (readonly var): Pages Save all and Discard all leave alone: Monitors applies with a keep/revert step, so it's saved on its page
- `canActOnAll` (readonly bool)
- `libraryGrouped` (readonly bool): The widget and module libraries show their types by group (the schema's `x-libraryGroups`), else by name
- `barStacked` (readonly bool): The bar editor draws a top or bottom bar's sections stacked down the side of the page, as a side bar's, rather than across it
- `keybindsFolded` (readonly var): The Keybinds editor's folded sections, by section name
- `typingField` (readonly var): The box holding typed text (var: callers use commitTyped() and discardTyped()), and the window it's in, so only that window's Save shows it
- `typingWindow` (readonly var)

### Functions

- `setLibraryGrouped(value)`
- `setBarStacked(value)`
- `setKeybindsFolded(section, folded)`
- `scrollOf(key)`
- `rememberScroll(key, y)`: Not a notifying write: nothing binds to it, it's read on restore
- `holdTyping(field, window)`
- `releaseTyping(field)`
- `commitTyping()`: Before a save: the typed text commits (dropped if it isn't valid yet)
- `discardTyping()`
- `discardTypingIn(item)`: Drops the typed text only if its box is inside `item` (one card's Discard)
- `isUnsaved(type)`
- `saveAll()`: Each save merges onto the latest config, so they don't undo each other.
- `discardAll()`
